name: Alternatingcasevowelconsonantshift

description_json.name: AlternatingCaseVowelConsonantShift
description_json.idea: To provide a highly effective obfuscation layer that breaks up recognizable word structures while remaining mathematically simple for the model to compute, we apply a dual-rule shift based on character type. All vowels (A, E, I, O, U, and lowercase equivalents) are shifted forward by 1 position in the vowel sequence (A->E, E->I, I->O, O->U, U->A). All consonants are shifted forward by 1 position in the alphabet sequence, skipping vowels (e.g., B->C, C->D, D->F, Z->B). Digits, spaces, and punctuation remain completely unchanged. Case is preserved for all letters.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is a vowel (case-insensitive), shift it to the next vowel in the sequence [A, E, I, O, U] (wrapping U to A), preserving the original case.
2. If it is a consonant (case-insensitive), shift it to the next consonant in the alphabet (skipping vowels and wrapping Z to B), preserving the original case.
3. If it is a digit, space, or punctuation mark, leave it unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is a vowel (case-insensitive), shift it to the previous vowel in the sequence [A, E, I, O, U] (wrapping A to U), preserving the original case.
2. If it is a consonant (case-insensitive), shift it to the previous consonant in the alphabet (skipping vowels and wrapping B to Z), preserving the original case.
3. If it is a digit, space, or punctuation mark, leave it unchanged.
